**Is Your Feature Request Related to a Problem?**

A clear description of the problem, e.g., "I cannot check X when designing Y…".

**Describe the Solution You'd Like**

What you want to happen. For calculation features, mention known references
(papers, other tools like BassBox Pro / Hornresp / WinISD) if any.

**Describe Alternatives You've Considered**

Any workaround you use today, or other tools that already do this.

**Scope**

- [ ] New enclosure type / model
- [ ] New graph or metric
- [ ] Calculator / tool improvement
- [ ] UI / UX
- [ ] Data (driver library, import/export)
- [ ] Other

**Additional Context**

Add any sketches, screenshots, or references here.
